newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE NOV 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE NOV 12.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- The newspaper quotes U.S. sources in New-York and Washington as saying the UN security council will vote this week to send a multinational force to help refugees in Zaire.
-- Insurer Axa launches a share exchange offer for UAP at an expected ratio of 10 UAP shares for four Axa shares. The new unit would post annual turnover of 310 billion francs.
-- EDF and GEC Alsthom win a three-billion-franc contract to build a coal-driven electricity plant in China.

-- Unions find new legal ways to delay planned job cuts at firms such as Danone , Sagem or Ciba-Geigy, while Prime Minister Alain Juppe calls for increased legal flexibility for firms to hire or dimsiss workers.
-- Nickel producer Eramet to review proposal to reallocate mining reserves in New Caledonia.
